exposure: use of indwelling medical device during delivery
cohort: 246 neonates with suspected sepsis admitted to the Dessie Comprehensive Specialized Hospital (DCSH) in Northeastern Ethiopia
finding: Bacterial growth was found in 27.2% of blood cultures, with E. coli and S. aureus being the predominant organisms, and both maternal and neonatal factors were associated with bacterial sepsis.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was statistically significantly associated with bacterial sepsis.
